query: update relays set name = coalesce($3, name), host = coalesce($4, host), port = coalesce($5, port), security = coalesce($6, security), max_connections = coalesce($7, max_connections), rate_limit_per_minute = coalesce($8, rate_limit_per_minute), enabled = coalesce($9, enabled), failover_order = coalesce($10, failover_order), username = case when $11 then $12 else username end, password_encrypted = case when $13 then $14 else password_encrypted end, updated_at = now() where workspace_id = $1 and id = $2 returning name, host
